board.startBody: No account needed. Name the board, name yourself, and pick a password the household will use to join.
board.passwordHint: Everyone who joins needs it. Say it out loud — it isn't a bank PIN.
board.shortPassword: The board password needs at least 6 characters.
board.createFailed: Could not create the board. Try again.
board.joinBody: Give your name and the board password.
board.joinRejected: That link and password do not match a board.
board.joinRateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes.
board.betaKeyHint: Menami is in a closed beta. The key comes with your invitation.
board.invalidBetaKey: That beta key is not right. Ask whoever invited you to the beta.
board.shareBody: Send the link and tell them the password separately.
board.anonymousWarning: This device is the only key to your seat on this board. Clearing browser data loses it.
board.dropHint: Drag a Meal anywhere, or tap it to plan it.
board.yourNameHint: Shown on meals you add — "Dad wants this".
board.keyWarning: This phone holds your key to the board. Clearing app data loses it — add an email later to keep it safe.
board.joinBodyNamed_one: {{names}} is already planning. Ask them for the board password.
board.joinBodyNamed_other: {{names}} are already planning. Ask one of them for the board password.
board.sharePasswordNote: The password is not shown here — it isn't stored, only checked. Tell them yourself.
board.inviteBody: Paste the link you were sent. If someone read it out, type the part after /join/.
board.inviteHint: The password comes separately — you'll be asked for it next.
board.inviteUnreadable: No invite link in there. Check you copied the whole thing.
board.dropHintTouch: Hold a Meal to carry it, or tap it to plan it.
board.leftoverOrder: Leftovers come after the Meal they are from. Move the Meal first.

settings.title: Settings
settings.slotsBody: Slots are the rows on every day of the board. They are the same for everyone in the household.
settings.removeKeepsMeals: Removing a slot keeps what was planned in it — put the slot back and the meals reappear.
settings.slotsFull: That is as many slots as a day column can hold.

error.duplicate-slot: That slot is already on the board.
error.too-many-slots: That is as many slots as a day column can hold.
error.last-slot: A board needs at least one slot.
error.name-required: Give the slot a name first.
error.writeFailed: Could not save the slots. Try again.
error.invalid-email: That does not look like an email address.
error.taken: That address is already on another account.
error.rate-limited: Too many links sent. Wait a few minutes.
error.unavailable: Could not send the link. Try again.

settings.emailWhy: This device is the only key to your seat. Add an email and a link will keep it safe.
settings.emailPending: Sent to {{email}}. Click the link in it — nothing changes until you do.
settings.appearanceHint: The board is light unless you say otherwise. This is remembered on this device.
settings.sizeHint: New meals start at this many servings. Meals you already have keep theirs.
settings.languageHint: The whole board speaks it — the catalogue and the shopping list too, for everyone in the household.
